Five golden petals surround a round center on this poinsettia ring, a Christmas flower set on a slim, closed band. The yellow gold design brings a botanical detail to winter jewelry, with no stones or enamel; wear it on its own or stack it with other rings.

- The integrated motif shows five petals with folds and raised lines, as seen in the design image.
- The slim, continuous band creates a floral stacking ring silhouette, made for delicate layering.
- The intended metal is yellow gold; gold karat and ring size are selected from the listing variations.
- No stones or enamel: the flower and the band are expressed entirely in metal.
- The listing is for one ring; the image is a design visualization, not a photograph of the finished piece.
- Sizes, final karat, measurements, weight, fit and production details will be confirmed before the design is offered for sale.

A Christmas-inspired poinsettia ring that also works with everyday stacks. Final specifications will be confirmed before sale.
4593814704:
This Christmas tree ring features a geometric fir silhouette cut into the satin face of a yellow gold band. The integrated motif adds a quiet holiday touch, while the closed band keeps a continuous form made for stacking with other pieces.

- The band has a satin surface and a gently widened face around the tree design.
- The pine motif is expressed as an opening in the metal, with no stones or enamel.
- The pierced pine design pairs a botanical reference with simple geometric lines.
- Choose your ring size and gold karat from the available options; final details will be confirmed before the design is offered for sale.
- The listing is for one ring; the images are design visualizations, not a finished piece.
- The intended metal is yellow gold, and the ring can be worn on its own or stacked with other rings.

This Christmas gold ring is part of the EON Christmas Collection and recalls the evergreen fir. Measurements, weight, fit and production details are not yet specified; they will be confirmed before the design is available.
